items.title: Friday, September 11th, 2026
items.summary: # Following on from the other day , I now have a /friends page. While it could be used as a blogroll, I'm taking it a bit wider including YouTube profiles and more. There's only a few names there for now but more will be added as I'm trying to be really thoughtful as to who I add.

You know what to do! 🫠 The listening party is scheduled for 8pm UK next Friday, 11th September.
